completeness.why: getDateWithSkippedWeekend now takes the skipWeekend flag and decides whether and how to move; getUpcomingDates passes its config fields, both template sites call getDayWithSkippedWeekend with their own fields, and getNextDate passes its parsed fields, keeping only its own noSkipWeekend option (a variation no other site has) outside.

interface.why: The flag and mode are the real variation and each caller maps its own field names, but a positional boolean plus mode is easy to misorder and getDayWithSkippedWeekend re-checks skipWeekend before delegating.
